visualCharacteristics.structure: button + link + image + heading + text + list

cells: Content: heading (article title, optionally linked), optional description paragraph, date paragraph (e.g. "16 September 2026"), "Find Out More" link to the article, optional "Download" link (press-kit zip)
contentPattern.notes: Slides fade every 5 s (paused on hover/focus and for reduced motion). A single row renders a static slide with no dots.

usage.description: Home / brand landing pages: rotating featured news slides with an action rail (download, cart, share) and dot pagination.

reuseGuidance: Use for the featured-news hero slider. For a static single hero use the hero block; for a horizontal strip of link tiles use carousel-brands.
designReference: Values lifted from stardust/prototypes (canon/modules.css and per-page css) where a counterpart exists.
